items.speaker: भीष्म उवाच
items.text:
इतीदं कीर्तनीयस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः।
नाम्नां सहस्रं दिव्यानामशेषेण प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
itīdaṃ kīrtanīyasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ|
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāmaśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam || 1 ||
items.en: Bhishma said: So I have told you in full these thousand divine names of the great Keshava, who is worthy of praise.

items.text:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चापि परिकीर्तयेत्।
नाशुभं प्राप्नुयात्किंचित्सोऽमुत्रेह च मानवः ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścāpi parikīrtayet|
nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyātkiṃcitso'mutreha ca mānavaḥ || 2 ||
items.en: A person who hears these names every day, or who recites them, meets no evil either in this world or in the next.

items.text:
वेदान्तगो ब्राह्मणः स्यात्क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत्।
वैश्यो धनसमृद्धः स्याच्छूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet|
vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syācchūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt || 3 ||
items.en: A Brahmin who does so masters the Vedanta, a Kshatriya wins victory, a Vaishya becomes rich, and a Shudra gains happiness.

items.text:
धर्मार्थी प्राप्नुयाद्धर्ममर्थार्थी चार्थमाप्नुयात्।
कामानवाप्नुयात्कामी प्रजार्थी चाप्नुयात्प्रजाम् ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
dharmārthī prāpnuyāddharmamarthārthī cārthamāpnuyāt|
kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī prajārthī cāpnuyātprajām || 4 ||
items.en: One who seeks dharma gains dharma, one who seeks wealth gains wealth, one who has desires gains them, and one who wants children gains children.

items.text:
भक्तिमान् यः सदोत्थाय शुचिस्तद्गतमानसः।
सहस्रं वासुदेवस्य नाम्नामेतत्प्रकीर्तयेत् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
bhaktimān yaḥ sadotthāya śucistadgatamānasaḥ|
sahasraṃ vāsudevasya nāmnāmetatprakīrtayet || 5 ||
items.en: A devoted person who rises early, is pure, keeps the mind fixed on Vasudeva and recites these thousand names,

items.text:
यशः प्राप्नोति विपुलं ज्ञातिप्राधान्यमेव च।
अचलां श्रियमाप्नोति श्रेयः प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulaṃ jñātiprādhānyameva ca|
acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti śreyaḥ prāpnotyanuttamam || 6 ||
items.en: gains wide fame and a leading place among his relatives. He gains lasting prosperity and the highest good.

items.text:
न भयं क्वचिदाप्नोति वीर्यं तेजश्च विन्दति।
भवत्यरोगो द्युतिमान्बलरूपगुणान्वितः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
na bhayaṃ kvacidāpnoti vīryaṃ tejaśca vindati|
bhavatyarogo dyutimānbalarūpaguṇānvitaḥ || 7 ||
items.en: He has no fear anywhere, and he gains strength and energy. He becomes free of disease, radiant, and blessed with strength, beauty and good qualities.

items.text:
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात्।
भयान्मुच्येत भीतस्तु मुच्येतापन्न आपदः ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt|
bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ || 8 ||
items.en: The sick are freed from illness, the bound from bondage, the frightened from fear, and those in trouble from trouble.

items.text:
दुर्गाण्यतितरत्याशु पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमम्।
स्तुवन्नामसहस्रेण नित्यं भक्तिसमन्वितः ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
durgāṇyatitaratyāśu puruṣaḥ puruṣottamam|
stuvannāmasahasreṇa nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ || 9 ||
items.en: A person who, full of devotion, praises the Supreme Person daily with these thousand names quickly crosses all difficulties.

items.text:
वासुदेवाश्रयो मर्त्यो वासुदेवपरायणः।
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा याति ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
vāsudevāśrayo martyo vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ|
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā yāti brahma sanātanam || 10 ||
items.en: A mortal who takes refuge in Vasudeva and holds him as the highest goal becomes pure, free of all sins, and reaches the eternal Brahman.

items.text:
न वासुदेवभक्तानामशुभं विद्यते क्वचित्।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिभयं नैवोपजायते ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
na vāsudevabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit|
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaṃ naivopajāyate || 11 ||
items.en: No evil ever comes to the devotees of Vasudeva. For them there is no fear of birth, death, old age or disease.

items.text:
इमं स्तवमधीयानः श्रद्धाभक्तिसमन्वितः।
युज्येतात्मसुखक्षान्तिश्रीधृतिस्मृतिकीर्तिभिः ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
imaṃ stavamadhīyānaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ|
yujyetātmasukhakṣāntiśrīdhṛtismṛtikīrtibhiḥ || 12 ||
items.en: One who studies this hymn with faith and devotion gains joy of the self, patience, prosperity, courage, good memory and fame.

items.text:
न क्रोधो न च मात्सर्यं न लोभो नाशुभा मतिः।
भवन्ति कृतपुण्यानां भक्तानां पुरुषोत्तमे ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ|
bhavanti kṛtapuṇyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame || 13 ||
items.en: Anger, jealousy, greed and evil thoughts do not arise in those good-hearted devotees of the Supreme Person.

items.text:
द्यौः सचन्द्रार्कनक्षत्रा खं दिशो भूर्महोदधिः।
वासुदेवस्य वीर्येण विधृतानि महात्मनः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
dyauḥ sacandrārkanakṣatrā khaṃ diśo bhūrmahodadhiḥ|
vāsudevasya vīryeṇa vidhṛtāni mahātmanaḥ || 14 ||
items.en: The sky with the moon, sun and stars, space, the directions, the earth and the great ocean are all held in place by the power of the great Vasudeva.

items.text:
ससुरासुरगन्धर्वं सयक्षोरगराक्षसम्।
जगद्वशे वर्ततेदं कृष्णस्य सचराचरम् ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
sasurāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam|
jagadvaśe vartatedaṃ kṛṣṇasya sacarācaram || 15 ||
items.en: This whole world, moving and unmoving, with gods, demons and Gandharvas, Yakshas, serpents and Rakshasas, is under the control of Krishna.

items.text:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिः सत्त्वं तेजो बलं धृतिः।
वासुदेवात्मकान्याहुः क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ|
vāsudevātmakānyāhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca || 16 ||
items.en: The senses, the mind, the intellect, goodness, energy, strength and courage, the body and the knower of the body: all these, it is said, have Vasudeva as their self.

items.text:
सर्वागमानामाचारः प्रथमं परिकल्प्यते।
आचारप्रभवो धर्मो धर्मस्य प्रभुरच्युतः ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
sarvāgamānāmācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpyate|
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhuracyutaḥ || 17 ||
items.en: Of all the scriptures, right conduct is placed first. Dharma is born from right conduct, and the lord of dharma is Achyuta.

items.text:
ऋषयः पितरो देवा महाभूतानि धातवः।
जङ्गमाजङ्गमं चेदं जगन्नारायणोद्भवम् ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā mahābhūtāni dhātavaḥ|
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ cedaṃ jagannārāyaṇodbhavam || 18 ||
items.en: The sages, the ancestors, the gods, the great elements and the substances of the body: this whole world, moving and unmoving, comes from Narayana.

items.text:
योगो ज्ञानं तथा सांख्यं विद्याः शिल्पादिकर्म च।
वेदाः शास्त्राणि विज्ञानमेतत्सर्वं जनार्दनात् ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṃkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpādikarma ca|
vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vijñānametatsarvaṃ janārdanāt || 19 ||
items.en: Yoga, knowledge, Sankhya, the sciences, the arts and crafts, the Vedas, the scriptures and all learning: all this comes from Janardana.

items.text:
एको विष्णुर्महद्भूतं पृथग्भूतान्यनेकशः।
त्रींल्लोकान्व्याप्य भूतात्मा भुङ्क्ते विश्वभुगव्ययः ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
eko viṣṇurmahadbhūtaṃ pṛthagbhūtānyanekaśaḥ|
trīṃllokānvyāpya bhūtātmā bhuṅkte viśvabhugavyayaḥ || 20 ||
items.en: Vishnu, the one great Being, appears separately as many beings. Pervading the three worlds, the undying Self of all beings enjoys them all.

items.text:
इमं स्तवं भगवतो विष्णोर्व्यासेन कीर्तितम्।
पठेद्य इच्छेत्पुरुषः श्रेयः प्राप्तुं सुखानि च ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
imaṃ stavaṃ bhagavato viṣṇorvyāsena kīrtitam|
paṭhedya icchetpuruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca || 21 ||
items.en: Whoever wants to gain the highest good and happiness should read this hymn to Lord Vishnu, sung by Vyasa.

items.text:
विश्वेश्वरमजं देवं जगतः प्रभुमव्ययम्।
भजन्ति ये पुष्कराक्षं न ते यान्ति पराभवम् ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
viśveśvaramajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhumavyayam|
bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam || 22 ||
items.en: Those who worship the lotus-eyed God, the unborn lord of the universe, the undying master of the world, never meet defeat.

items.text:
न ते यान्ति पराभवम् ॐ नम इति।
अर्जुन उवाच।
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्ष पद्मनाभ सुरोत्तम।
भक्तानामनुरक्तानां त्राता भव जनार्दन ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
na te yānti parābhavam oṃ nama iti|
arjuna uvāca|
padmapatraviśālākṣa padmanābha surottama|
bhaktānāmanuraktānāṃ trātā bhava janārdana || 23 ||
items.en: 'They never meet defeat: Om, salutation.' Arjuna said: O lotus-navelled one, with eyes wide as lotus petals, best of gods, Janardana, be the protector of your loving devotees.

items.text:
यो मां नामसहस्रेण स्तोतुमिच्छति पाण्डव।
सोऽहमेकेन श्लोकेन स्तुत एव न संशयः ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
yo māṃ nāmasahasreṇa stotumicchati pāṇḍava|
so'hamekena ślokena stuta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 24 ||
items.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
items.en: The Blessed Lord said: Son of Pandu, whoever wishes to praise me with the thousand names, I am truly praised even by one verse; there is no doubt.

items.text:
स्तुत एव न संशय ॐ नम इति।
व्यास उवाच।
वासनाद्वासुदेवस्य वासितं भुवनत्रयम्।
सर्वभूतनिवासोऽसि वासुदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
stuta eva na saṃśaya oṃ nama iti|
vyāsa uvāca|
vāsanādvāsudevasya vāsitaṃ bhuvanatrayam|
sarvabhūtanivāso'si vāsudeva namo'stu te || 25 ||
items.en: 'Truly praised, there is no doubt: Om, salutation.' Vyasa said: The three worlds are filled with Vasudeva, as a place is filled with fragrance. You dwell in all beings, Vasudeva; salutation to you.

items.text:
श्रीवासुदेव नमोऽस्तु त ॐ नम इति।
पार्वत्युवाच।
केनोपायेन लघुना विष्णोर्नामसहस्रकम्।
पठ्यते पण्डितैर्नित्यं श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं प्रभो ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
śrīvāsudeva namo'stu ta oṃ nama iti|
pārvatyuvāca|
kenopāyena laghunā viṣṇornāmasahasrakam|
paṭhyate paṇḍitairnityaṃ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ prabho || 26 ||
items.en: 'Salutation to you, Vasudeva: Om, salutation.' Parvati said: Lord, I wish to hear by what easy means the learned recite the thousand names of Vishnu every day.

items.text:
रामरामेति रामेति रमे रामे मनोरमे ।
सहस्रनामतत्तुल्यं रामनाम वरानने ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
rāmarāmeti rāmeti rame rāme manorame |
sahasranāmatattulyaṃ rāmanāma varānane || 27 ||
items.speaker: ईश्वर उवाच
items.en: Ishvara (Shiva) said: O lovely-faced one, I delight in Rama, the delight of the mind, by saying 'Rama, Rama, Rama'. The name Rama is equal to the thousand names.

items.text:
श्रीरामनाम वरानन ॐ नम इति।
ब्रह्मोवाच।
नमोऽस्त्वनन्ताय सहस्रमूर्तये
सहस्रपादाक्षिशिरोरुबाहवे।
items.tr:
śrīrāmanāma varānana oṃ nama iti|
brahmovāca|
namo'stvanantāya sahasramūrtaye
sahasrapādākṣiśirorubāhave|
items.en: 'The name of Rama, O lovely-faced one: Om, salutation.' Brahma said: Salutation to the endless one with a thousand forms, with a thousand feet, eyes, heads, thighs and arms,

items.text:
सहस्रनाम्ने पुरुषाय शाश्वते
सहस्रकोटियुगधारिणे नमः ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate
sahasrakoṭiyugadhāriṇe namaḥ || 28 ||
items.en: to the eternal Person with a thousand names, who upholds thousands of millions of ages: salutation.

items.text: सहस्रकोटियुगधारिणे नम ॐ नम इति।
items.tr: sahasrakoṭiyugadhāriṇe nama oṃ nama iti|
items.en: 'To him who upholds thousands of millions of ages, salutation: Om, salutation.'

items.speaker: सञ्जय उवाच
items.text:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ|
tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama || 29 ||
items.en: Sanjaya said: Wherever there is Krishna, the lord of yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna the archer, there, I believe, are fortune, victory, prosperity and firm justice.

items.text:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate|
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham || 30 ||
items.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
items.en: The Blessed Lord said: Those people who worship me, thinking of no one else, always joined to me: I bring them what they lack and protect what they have.

items.text:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām|
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya saṃbhavāmi yuge yuge || 31 ||
items.en: To protect the good, to destroy the wicked, and to set dharma firmly in place, I come into being age after age.

items.text:
आर्ता विषण्णाः शिथिलाश्च भीता घोरेषु च व्याधिषु वर्तमानाः।
संकीर्त्य नारायणशब्दमात्रं विमुक्तदुःखाः सुखिनो भवन्तु ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
ārtā viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāśca bhītā ghoreṣu ca vyādhiṣu vartamānāḥ|
saṃkīrtya nārāyaṇaśabdamātraṃ vimuktaduḥkhāḥ sukhino bhavantu || 32 ||
items.en: May those who are suffering, sad, weak and afraid, or caught in terrible diseases, be freed from pain and become happy by simply singing the word 'Narayana'.

items.text:
कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा बुद्ध्यात्मना वा प्रकृतिस्वभावात्।
करोमि यद्यत्सकलं परस्मै नारायणायेति समर्पयामि ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
kāyena vācā manasendriyairvā buddhyātmanā vā prakṛtisvabhāvāt|
karomi yadyatsakalaṃ parasmai nārāyaṇāyeti samarpayāmi || 33 ||
items.en: Whatever I do with body, speech, mind or senses, with intellect or self, or by the habit of my nature, I offer it all to the Supreme Narayana.

items.text: इति श्रीविष्णोर्दिव्यसहस्रनामस्तोत्रं सम्पूर्णम् ॥
items.tr: iti śrīviṣṇordivyasahasranāmastotraṃ sampūrṇam ||
items.en: Thus ends the divine hymn of the thousand names of Vishnu.
